analysis_kind: exploratory follow-up; original failed analysis remains unchanged
tolerance_18_meaning: no sector filtering on 18 measured modes
fit: per-Pauli y=m*x+c*T+b; original fixed ridge toward identity
training: the original six U=0 training settings only
selection: mean squared error over all 27 Z/onsite-ZZ observables at the two U=0 holdout times
selection_baseline: unmitigated raw means are eligible; prefer raw on a tie
filter_tie_break: prefer the larger tolerance on an equal score
U8_boundary: U=8 references and measurements never enter candidate selection or fitting
disclosure: Raw U=8 results were inspected earlier; this is not a fresh blinded confirmatory test
selection_freeze: write choice and model before computing U=8 corrected results
primary_target_metric: mean squared Pauli error pooled over both U=8 time points; paired improvement versus raw
bootstrap: resample common twirl IDs jointly, then shots within each setting/twirl; refit and reselect on U=0 each time
confidence_intervals: 95 percent percentile intervals; also report fixed-selected-filter intervals
extra_mitigation: no MESR, GPR, symmetry averaging, or new ridge tuning
circuit_track: Optimize only consecutive one-qubit gates before binding; preserve CZ count, per-wire CZ ordering, measurement map and readout masks
circuit_validation: QPY round-trip, all 80 binding skeletons, small full-operator tests and selected full 18-qubit statevector comparisons
circuit_claim_boundary: New optimized circuits are not hardware-tested; old data cannot measure their improvement
